title: Two Skills Mage
description: Two Skills Mage — The Townstons wiki
html:
An effective Mage build will often combine two different types of skills. Doing so will result in special name for your character, as shown in the following table:

Combination Divine Poison Fire Ice Shadow
Divine Divine Inquisitor Ambrosial Scoundrel Solar Vanquisher Auroric Fighter Pandemonical Vanquisher
Poison Venom Wizard Sulfuric Scout Cyrocidic Watchman Chaotic Scout
Fire Pyromancer Entropic Mage Obsidian Mage
Ice Ice Wizard Hydrostatic Mage
Shadow Shadow Runner

The naming system is not fully explored so other names may be possible. These have actually been seen in play. See a Tested Healthy Obsidian Mage for an example.

In general, a Mage with three or more skill types will be an Arcane Mage.
